changed_surfaces.purpose: Resolve global system and project-scoped effective permissions and route catalog.
Parse/validate request project context and filter routes using the same permission set as me/authorities.
Apply X-Project-Id on every authenticated request and reject invalid or path-mismatched context.
Use request project context for me and routes.
Inject JSON serializer into project-context filter errors.
Allow authenticated first-login workbench discovery before a project is selected.
Keep workbench member-scoped and stop projectless helpers from reading old system business-role rows.
Verify permission separation, project context, route ancestry and path/header consistency.
